name: Tinker cooldown passives shorten their own spells (#1705, #1362)
contract: #1705 Trust the Science! 300653 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER -5000 on SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (DBC EffectBasePoints -5001, DieSides 1) with class mask 0x4, which selects the Zap! ranks 680196/681296/681297/681298 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x4, RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, AttributesEx6 0 so SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS does not block the category branch). #1362 Bunker Operative 801706 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER -20 on the same op (EffectBasePoints -21, DieSides 1) with mask 0x2000/0x8000/0x400, which selects Discombobulate! 807197 (20000 ms), Build: Repulsion Unit 706904 (90000 ms) and Kinetic Shield 806224 (300000 ms); it sets SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED, so its Stances value does not stop the passive applying out of form. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN at Player.cpp:11452 and :11456. Repair Shot 801707 is the control: SpellFamilyName 34, in neither mask.

steps.label: Zap! starts on its DBC 15 second cooldown
Trust the Science! takes 5 seconds off Zap!
Bunker Operative takes 20% off Kinetic Shield
Bunker Operative takes 20% off Build: Repulsion Unit
Repair Shot is in neither mask
The real cooldown is now 10 seconds
Kinetic Shield's real cooldown is 240 seconds
